subject: Post-call: MAP draft & legal redlines ownership - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft & legal redlines ownership - next steps

Samir / Tanya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the Mutual Action Plan (MAP):

Summary of call:
- Agreed scope: pilot integration of Redwood inference runtime for Acme Map routing feature (production target after pilot).
- Key MAP milestones: pilot kickoff, pilot evaluation (SLOs/latency), commercial terms (MSA/DPA/SLA), procurement/signature, production rollout.

MAP milestone we discussed today (legal redlines):
- Who owns initial edits: Acme legal will perform the first pass and provide redlines to Redwood.
- Redwood to provide a clean MSA/DPA/SLA template (clean copy) for Acme legal to redline.
- Turnaround expectations: Acme suggested 3–5 business days for initial redlines; Redwood requests 2–3 business days to review/respond once we receive redlines.
- Escalation path: if material commercial terms are requested, loop in Rishi + Redwood legal (Neha).

Dependencies and blockers:
- Acme procurement requires SOC 2 Type II and a standard DPA; we have SOC2 report (link below) and can provide audit evidence via our security portal.
- DocuSign access for signatures; please confirm signatory names.

Proposed immediate actions (please confirm):
1) Acme legal (Samir/Tanya) owns initial redline pass and will upload redlines to the shared Drive by Wed 7/22.
2) Redwood (Neha + Marissa) will provide a clean MSA/DPA/SLA by EOD 7/16 and commit to a 2 business-day review turnaround on incoming redlines.
3) Sales (Rishi) to align on target close date: proposed 2026-08-05 for fully executed agreement assuming no material commercial negotiations.

Attachments: draft MAP + placeholder MSA (see attached docs).

Please confirm ownership/turnaround and whether the above target close date looks realistic from your side.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123
